heading.title: Of Certain Relations Resembling Those Created by Contract

article.title: Responsibility of finder of goods.
article.content:
71Responsibility of finder of goods.

Section 71  ·  Chapter V  ·  page 29 of the Act
A person who finds goods belonging to another, and takes them into his custody, is subject to the same responsibility as a bailee2.
2 See ss. 151 and 152, infra.
